_note: Friendly names, help text and grouping for the Settings window's theme editor. Presentation only: this file never decides which tokens exist. Every token the active preset carries gets a row whether or not it is listed here (falling back to a name derived from the token itself), and an entry here for a token no preset defines is ignored. So it never has to be exhaustive, and a token added by a mod still appears.
_groups: One entry per token group. 'order' lists the buckets (the segment before the first dot) in the order they should appear; buckets not listed follow alphabetically. A bucket holding only one token is folded into a trailing 'Other' group unless it is named in 'buckets' below.
_buckets: Naming a bucket here also rescues a single-token one from the 'Other' group.
_tokens: 'washed' marks a colour a translucent fill is derived from, which therefore cannot be a palette() expression. 'text_on' marks one that styles text and is held to the contrast floor.

accent.label: Accent
accent.hint: The app's one highlight colour: selection, a clickable card's edge, a live drop target.

accent.dice.label: Dice accent
accent.dice.hint: The roll readouts and the dice roller's own highlight.

tint.better.label: Better
tint.better.hint: A number improved by an extra or a boost.

tint.worse.label: Worse
tint.worse.hint: A number limited by a flaw, a penalty, a rejected drop.

tint.warning.label: Warning
tint.warning.hint: A Power Level breach or an over-spend: worth seeing, not an error.

tint.homerule.label: Home rule
tint.homerule.hint: A cost or cap the group has changed from the printed rules.

surface.window.label: Window
surface.window.hint: The page behind the sheet's blocks. Styled presets only.

surface.titlebar.label: Block title bar
surface.titlebar.hint: The drag handle above each block.

surface.card.label: Card
surface.card.hint: A power card, a player card, a modifier chip.

surface.field.label: Input field
surface.field.hint: Behind a spin box, combo box or line edit.

text.primary.label: Primary
text.primary.hint: Ordinary body text. Styled presets only.

text.muted.label: Muted
text.muted.hint: A secondary line that recedes without vanishing. May be a palette() role.

text.muted.rich.label: Muted (rich text)
text.muted.rich.hint: The same shade for HTML labels, which cannot resolve a palette() role.

text.on-badge.label: On a badge
text.on-badge.hint: Text sitting on one of the filled badges below.

border.card.label: Card
border.card.hint: May be a palette() role so it follows the OS.

border.group.label: Group box
border.group.hint: The frame around a titled group.

border.block.label: Block
border.block.hint: Around a sheet block. Styled presets only.

border.empty.label: Empty target
border.empty.hint: The dashed outline of a canvas with nothing in it.

badge.extra.label: Extra
badge.extra.hint: The chip for an extra bought onto an effect.

badge.flaw.label: Flaw
badge.flaw.hint: The chip for a flaw taken on an effect.

badge.flat.label: Flat modifier
badge.flat.hint: A modifier costing flat points rather than per rank.

badge.role.linked.label: Linked effect
badge.role.linked.hint: A member of a linked bundle.

drop.indicator.label: Drop indicator
drop.indicator.hint: The bar showing where a dragged block will land.

drop.reject.label: Rejected drop
drop.reject.hint: Shown when a target refuses the payload over it.

focus.ring.label: Ring colour
focus.ring.hint: The focused control's outline — the only visible sign that it will now take the scroll wheel.

dice.face.label: Die face
dice.face.hint: The rolled number in the dice roller.

radius.card.label: Card
radius.card.hint: Also the fallback for any radius a preset leaves unstated.

border.width.accent-edge.label: Accent edge
border.width.accent-edge.hint: The standing left edge that marks a power card as clickable.

card.margins.label: Margins
card.margins.hint: Left, top, right, bottom — inside a live power card.

card.margins.off.label: Margins (switched off)
card.margins.off.hint: Tighter: a switched-off card sits a notch smaller.

opacity.inactive.label: Switched-off card
opacity.inactive.hint: 0 is invisible, 1 is fully lit. A card eases to this when switched off.

platform.features.height.label: Platform Features list
platform.features.height.hint: How tall the scrolling Feature list in the vehicle/installation editor is, in pixels.

die.size.label: Die
die.size.hint: How big the d20 is drawn, in pixels. Square.

die.size.compact.label: Die (compact mode)
die.size.compact.hint: The smaller die the mini roller uses, so the whole window fits in a screen corner.

die.padding.label: Die padding
die.padding.hint: Room around the drawing inside its button, in pixels.

compact.width.label: Window width
compact.width.hint: What the mini roller opens at, in pixels.

compact.min-width.label: Minimum width
compact.min-width.hint: How small the mini roller may be dragged before it starts scrolling instead.

compact.button.label: Shrink button
compact.button.hint: The diameter of the round button floating over the roller's bottom-right corner, in pixels.

column.settings.label.label: Settings labels
column.settings.label.hint: The width this very column is wrapped to.

column.settings.value.label: Settings values
column.settings.value.hint: How wide a value field beside it may grow.

column.hero-point.label: Hero point pip
column.hero-point.hint: The medallion is square, so this is its height too.

column.status-dot.label: Connection dot
column.status-dot.hint: The dot beside the connection state in the menu bar corner. Round, so this is its height too.

family.label: Font family
family.hint: Leave on the platform default unless you have a reason; the app never sets a size in a stylesheet, so an unusual family can reflow a lot.

size.terms.label: Game terms
size.terms.hint: The small print under a power's effects.

size.compact-button.label: Shrink button glyph
size.compact-button.hint: The arrow inside the round button over the roller. Sized against compact.button, the circle it has to fill.

scale.inactive.label: Switched-off card
scale.inactive.hint: How much a switched-off power card shrinks. 1.0 is no change.
